node.title: AQB average-to-member transfer
node.statement: For a finite AQB averaged quotient-box family, if the family-average list contribution exceeds the MCA trigger after the certified shared entropy gain is applied, then at least one member of the family individually exceeds the trigger and gives an unsafe witness at sigma*.
node.attack_surface: finite averaging/pigeonhole transfer from average excess to one member excess
node.falsifier: a finite family whose average exceeds a threshold while every member is at or below that threshold
